items.title: Mike Davis interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, April 1, 2024
items.q: I kind of learned that from my years of a couple of decades of being in Bob Mintzer’s band

ctx.x: Well go ahead ‘cause I’m not either.

I mean I could, in a really horrific way sing the melody that Cole wrote, but yeah I think I would probably say that I — in my own writing and I think Cole does the same thing — we really like to have some level of accessibility to it so that it feels like, you know, what you just described, and I really appreciate that, because that’s definitely something we’re going for. And I kind of learned that from my years of a couple of decades of being in Bob Mintzer’s band and I’ve always been a huge Bob fan and I’m so…

I wrote down a note here saying it must be a luxury to write for players like that who are going to play it so wonderfully. And then I realized that it’s a luxury that you may have to pay for yourself.
